name: Self-Doubt
description: A fog of 'I can't do this' hangs across the doorway.

name: Impulsive Anger
description: A wall of heat flares whenever you approach the exit.

name: Misunderstanding
description: A figure blocks the way, certain you meant them harm.

name: Apathy
description: A heavy grey curtain whispers that nothing is worth the effort.

name: Interpersonal Conflict
description: Two voices argue loudly in front of the door, refusing to yield.

name: Setback
description: The path ahead has collapsed; you must begin a section again.

name: Sudden Change
description: The corridor rearranges itself the moment you understand it.

name: Repeated Failure
description: A gate that has rejected you before stands shut once more.

name: Isolation
description: Silence presses in; the exit seems impossible to reach alone.

name: Burnout
description: Every step costs everything; the final door asks why you keep going.
